verbatimWebsiteContent.homeWelcome: The Hotel Satya International is classified three star hotel in Singrauli (M.P.) India rising high above the high-rise landscape of the city’s Main Road, Belaunji area. Everything inside glistens with the pristine purity of newness, and guests cannot help but marvel at the indulgently lavish decor and innovative artistic design. The Hotel Satya International, a tradition of gracious living and the pride of the city and the hallmark of luxury is conveniently located in the heart of Singrauli (M.P.), within minutes of proximity to airport and railway station.
verbatimWebsiteContent.aboutUs: The Hotel Satya International; where hospitality is a constantly changing visage upgrading daily keeping pace with the latest trends. Synthesizing convenience, comfort and luxury to compliment business and leisure needs. It is here that style meets luxury to give you your exclusive. It is here that you hold the keys to the rooms full of ideas. The delicacies of the world converge to indulge your gourmet desires. It is here that personalized and efficient service ensures your comfort every moment. Our tireless efforts to deliver the best has today given us the strength to stretch our wings wide and beyond. Our journey began in the year 2011, a journey where we never had sleeked a fixed destination but reaching milestones. Proud to come up with Singrauli’s first three-star hotel, In the year to come discover us and experience new star at different places in India. Today Hotel Satya International is synonymous to crowning comfort, incomparable business pleasure, unparalleled service and premium luxury and leisure apart from being situated in prime locations. Welcome to Hotel Satya International, we cherish your valued presence. Traditional yet contemporary, elegant and plush we make The Hotel Satya International suit every need. From the corporate visitor to the tourist, the food connoisseur to the party-maniac we present the diverse characteristic of our facilities. The large banquets, the open air lawn, the well furnished rooms, the specialty restaurants it has always been our endeavor to re position the brand Hotel Satya International, to excel in your heart with our service.

verbatimWebsiteContent.aboutSingrauli: The area in the eastern part of the state of MP and the adjoining southern part of Sonebhadra district in the state of UP is collectively known as Singrauli. Singrauli is emerging as India’s Energy capital, the place earlier known as Shringavali, named after the sage Shringi, was once upon a time covered with dense and unnavigable forests and inhabited by wild animals. The place was considered so treacherous that it was used by the Kings of Rewa State, who ruled the area till 1947, as an open air prison for detaining errant civilians and officers. Just two generations ago, small holders were tending their parcels of land here, and the original inhabitants were gathering honey and herbs in the forest. In the late fifties, a large scale dam banked up the water of the River Rihand. The dam known as Govind Vallabh Pant Sagar, was inaugurated by Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru in 1962. Later, rich coal deposits spread over an area of 2200 km2 in the state of M.P. (eastern part of Sidhi District) and U.P. (southern part of Sonebhadra District) were discovered close to the artificial lake that could be used to generate electricity.
verbatimWebsiteContent.servicesOverview: The Hotel has 24-hour Room Service facility, Swimming pool, Health Club, Doctor’s on call, free Wi-Fi connectivity, Satellite Television, Hot Water Supply, Cosmetic and Bathing Supplements and Access for disabled people, with Newspapers and other perquisites are provided by our hotel. The travel desk can help you to provide transport facilities as well as to book railway and air tickets. Garage and Secured parking is also available.
verbatimWebsiteContent.shardaRestaurantAndBakery: A multi cuisine family restaurant with a variety of cuisines like Indian, Continental, Chinese, Mughlai, Italian, Oriental etc. The Hotel’s proposal: order 100% original custom Bakery offers different varieties of desserts and custom made cakes for various occasions including wedding cakes. All confectionery products are made with the use of European technologies, fresh ingredients.
verbatimWebsiteContent.blueDiamondBar: Enjoy the warm, welcoming atmosphere and delicious beverages available at this Waidhan business Hotel’s colonial-style Blue Diamond Bar. You can choose between various Imported Liquor, mocktails and signature cocktails mixed by knowledgeable bartenders, and every drink is served in an imported, crystal-clear glass. Complimentary snacks are served with cocktails. The exclusive lounge-bar at the Hotel Satya International opens up to an infinite realm of indulgence. This elegant lounge-bar combines gracious service, global gourmet delights & most premium spirits. Having introduced the refined pleasures of lounge culture to the city, it gives guests the perfect venue to relax and unwind with electric beats of international & domestic music. Bar Timing: 11:00 am – 11:00 pm (Last order @ 10:30 pm).
